clips.title: The story
paras: At the northern safari camp in Stranglethorn Vale, the hunter Ajeck Rouack offers to train adventurers in the discipline of big cat stalking. She starts newcomers against the younger tigers prowling near the camp to test basic hunting and tracking prowess.

Having learned the art of hunting tigers from her father when she was a girl, Ajeck Rouack shares his craft with travelers who reach Nesingwary's Expedition following Welcome to the Jungle. She insists that tracking and slaying the youngest felines is the essential foundation before any hunter can advance to greater quarry.

Young Stranglethorn tigers are often found in the jungle close to the expedition camp. Rouack demands that ten of these beasts be hunted down to prove sufficient skill before she agrees to provide any further training.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When I was but a young girl, my father trained me in the art of tiger hunting.
You'll find the young felines much easier to track and slay. For this reason, we'll start you out easy. One can often find young tigers near the expedition camp.
Test your tracking skills and see if you can hunt some of the beasts down.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I don't feel confident in training you further, friend, until you have proven yourself skilled in slaying the youngest of the tigers first.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Nicely done, friend. You are ready to move on.
